articleTitle: High power 1.3 /spl mu/m single mode lasers
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: 1.3 /spl mu/m single mode InGaAsP-InP MQW lasers with record output powers are reported. 390 mW has been obtained from Fabry Perot lasers and 315 mW from DFB lasers. Over 150 mW was coupled into a single mode fiber.

articleTitle: Monolithic integrated DFB laser with electroabsorption modulator by identical active layer structure composed of two different QW types
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: The first monolithic integration of a 1.55 /spl mu/m ridge waveguide DFB laser with an EA modulator using an identical active MOW-layer structure composed of two different QW types is reported. Minimum threshold currents of 17 mA, voltage swing <1.5 V for 10 dB extinction ratio and 2 Gbit/s modulation capability are obtained.

articleTitle: Tensile-strained single quantum well 808 nm lasers with Al-free active regions and InGaAlP cladding layers grown by solid source MBE
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We report reliable 40 W bars and highly efficient (56%) single emitter 808 nm InGaAsP-GaAs quantum well lasers with Al-free active regions. We have demonstrated excellent performance characteristics of high power 808 nm single emitter lasers and bars with Al-free active region grown by solid source molecular beam epitaxy (SSMBE).

articleTitle: Transform limit optical pulse at 40 GHz from a 1.55 /spl mu/m module with an integrated DFB laser/electroabsorption modulator
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: A 40 GHz pulse source module at 1.55 /spl mu/m has been realized with an integrated MQW DFB laser/electroabsorption modulator: 6 ps pulse width, with 12 dB dynamic extinction ratio has been obtained with low driving voltage.

articleTitle: Power and facet phase dependence of chirp for index and gain-coupled DFB lasers
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: The adiabatic chirp of DFB semiconductor lasers is shown to be power and facet phase dependent. Importance of this effect on transmission is demonstrated using BER measurements, showing an advantage for gain-coupled lasers versus index-coupled devices.

articleTitle: Single-mode and multimode 2D VCSEL arrays for parallel optical interconnects
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We present bottom-emitting 4×8 InGaAs VCSEL arrays with homogeneous output characteristics ideally suited for transmitter action in short-distance optical interconnects. Conversion efficiencies of single-mode and multimode devices at an optical output power of 1 mW are 24% and 29%, respectively, with peak single-mode powers of 3 mW.

articleTitle: Optical properties of angled-grating distributed feedback lasers
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We report on new measurements of optical properties of high power /spl alpha/-DFB lasers including 0.7 W fiber-coupled power from a high power (1.5 W) /spl alpha/-DFB laser, and new RIN, wavefront and reliability measurement results.

articleTitle: High slope efficiency and low noise in tapered-active-stripe DFB lasers with narrow beam divergence
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: The highest slope efficiency and the very low noise characteristics are for the first time reported in strained quantum well DFB lasers with narrow beam divergence by employment of a laterally tapered active stripe over the whole cavity.

articleTitle: Analysis of transverse modes of nitride-based laser diodes
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: The analysis of the perpendicular far field patterns of nitride-based laser diodes with various types of AlGaN cladding layers is demonstrated. Other results obtained with our nitride-based laser diodes are also demonstrated and discussed.

articleTitle: Complex spectral behaviour of the waveguide modes in GaInN/GaN laser structures
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We have investigated GaInN-GaN laser structures with regard to their waveguiding properties. Both experimental and theoretical studies revealed a highly complex mode behaviour, caused by the existence and the interplay between the several guided transverse modes, and dependent on the wavelength.

articleTitle: Highly reliable operation of high-power 0.98-/spl mu/m InGaAs/InGaAsP lasers with a window structure fabricated by Si implantation
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We have developed 0.98-/spl mu/m InGaAs-InGaAsP lasers with a window structure fabricated by Si implantation. During testing at 240 mW, lasers showed stable operation with an estimated lifetime of more than 200,000 hours at 25/spl deg/C.

articleTitle: Low threshold 9 channel waveguide grating router based CW transmitter
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We demonstrate a 9-channel waveguide grating router based laser with low (18-22 mA) thresholds. This result was achieved through a combination of techniques including reduced intra-cavity loss, improved router design and optimal active/passive transitions.

articleTitle: Highly reliable GaInAs/GaInP 0.98 /spl mu/m window laser
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: A GaInAs-GaInP 0.98 /spl mu/m window strained SQW laser was fabricated for the first time using a selective nitrogen ion implantation and a subsequent annealing. Remarkable tolerances to a catastrophic optical destruction (COD) and an internal degradation have been obtained.

articleTitle: Simultaneous laser wavelength locking and spectral filtering using fiber Bragg grating
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We demonstrate an optical scheme allowing for simultaneous wavelength locking and spectral filtering using a single fiber Bragg grating. We observe substantial increase of extinction ratio and reduction of the wavelength chirp. The scheme also provides stable wavelength necessary for dense WDM system applications.

articleTitle: Adjustable multiwavelength laser arrays with sampled grating DBR mirrors
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Multiwavelength InP-InGaAsP MQW laser arrays with 100-GHz wavelength spacing were designed using sampled grating DBR lasers. Arrays of eight wavelengths, each has better than 30 dB MSR, have been obtained with a simple tuning mechanism.

articleTitle: Semiconductor lasers with 2.5 Gb/s operation at 200/spl deg/C
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We demonstrate the first high speed InGaAs QW semiconductor lasers at 200°C. For p-p drive currents of 30 mA and 7.5 mA, operation at 2.5 Gb/s and 1.2 Gb/s are demonstrated, respectively.

articleTitle: Double-fused 1.5 /spl mu/m vertical cavity lasers operating continuous wave up to 71/spl deg/C
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We report record high temperature performance of long wavelength vertical cavity lasers, operating continuous-wave up to 71/spl deg/C. A record high long wavelength characteristic temperature (T/sub o/) of 132 K has been measured over an operating range of -75/spl deg/C to 35/spl deg/C.

articleTitle: Effects of well number on temperature characteristics in 1.3-/spl mu/m AlGaInAs/InP quantum well lasers
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Effects of well number on temperature characteristics have been investigated in 1.3-/spl mu/m AlGaInAs-InP multiple-quantum-well (MQW) lasers. A record high pulsed operating temperature of 220/spl deg/C has been achieved in lasers with 10 QWs and a small power reduction of -1.68 dB between 20 and 80/spl deg/C has been obtained in lasers with 4 QWs.

articleTitle: Light-emitting devices with one- and two-dimensional air/semiconductor gratings embedded by wafer fusion technique
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We report on DFB MQW light-emitting devices with one- and two-dimensional air/semiconductor gratings inside a semiconductor. After demonstrating a CW oscillation of a 1D device, we show a very unique properties of 2D device which reflects the photonic band characteristic.

articleTitle: Thermal crosstalk of integrated multiwavelength transmitters
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Simulations and experimental results on thermal crosstalk of integrated ridge waveguide DFB multiwavelength laser transmitter sources are presented. The thermal resistance of the laser to heat sink transition is a crucial parameter. Thermal crosstalk can be eliminated by a simple on-chip temperature control.

articleTitle: High temperature self-pulsation in 650 nm wavelength, AlGaInP lasers with an epitaxially integrated saturable absorber
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: AlGaInP MQW lasers have been fabricated with n or p-doped absorbing epitaxial layers. Self-pulsation is seen, up to a temperature of 100/spl deg/C. In the p-doped devices which have an absorber recovery time of 0.4 ns.

articleTitle: Optical feedback modeling in integrated laser Mach-Zehnder modulators: application to frequency chirp monitoring by AM measurements
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: The feedback induced chirp in an integrated laser Mach-Zehnder modulator is for the first time monitored by measuring the AM response of the laser and compared to theory. The method simplifies investigation of facet phases effect and allows the comparison between different ILMZ configurations.

articleTitle: Single mode and stable polarization InGaAs/GaAs surface emitting laser grown on GaAs [311]B substrate
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We demonstrate a completely single-mode and single-polarization operations of a InGaAs/GaAs vertical-cavity surface emitting laser (VCSEL) grown on a GaAs [311]B substrate. The device operates in a single transverse and longitudinal mode, with stable polarization state in the entire tested current range.

articleTitle: Improved efficiency of small area selectively oxidized VCSELs
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We demonstrate increasing slope efficiency with decreasing aperture size for 850 nm selectively oxidized VCSELs (GaAs/AlGaAs) as small as 0.5/spl times/0.5 /spl mu/m. Thin apertures are positioned at a longitudinal field null within 3/4-/spl lambda/ thick high index layers.

articleTitle: Gain spectra measurement of strained and strain compensated InGaAsP/AlGaAs laser structures for /spl lambda//spl ap/800 nm using a new variable stripe length method
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Gain spectra are determined by a new variable stripe length method using current injection. The method is used for investigations of compressively strained and strain compensated InGaAsP-AlGaAs laser structures for wavelengths near 800 nm.

articleTitle: Reliable high-temperature 50-70 mW CW operation of 659-nm window-mirror laser diodes
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: A window-mirror laser diode (LD) with a long cavity length of 900-/spl mu/m lasing at 658.8 nm has shown a kink-free maximum output power of 141 mW. Even at 80/spl deg/C, CW maximum output power of 95 mW is obtained. Highly reliable operation for over 2,000 hours under the CW conditions of 70 mW at 60/spl deg/C and 50 mW at 70/spl deg/C has been realized, for the first time.

articleTitle: Densely packed high power VCSEL arrays
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We report on bottom emitting oxide confined InGaAs MQW VCSEL arrays with high packing densities emitting at 980 nm wavelength. CW output powers of 560 mW at room temperature resulting in 330 W/cm/sup 2/ spatially averaged optical power density are achieved using appropriate heat sinking.

articleTitle: Lasing at 1.3 /spl mu/m in strained quantum well lasers on InGaAs ternary substrates
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: The InGaAs ternary substrates with an indium composition of 0.31 and 1.3 /spl mu/m strained quantum well lasers on them have been obtained for the first time. The temperature sensitivity of slope efficiency is -0.007 dB/K.

articleTitle: Optimization of VCSEL with an integrated resonant photodetector
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We show that the intracavity detector-VCSEL performance depends critically on the relative alignment of the Fabry-Perot wavelength and the quantum-well absorber band edge. By strategic design, we obtain well-matched behavior of the internal and external detectors-up to 5 times threshold. Comprehensive modeling agrees with experimental results.

articleTitle: High-yield external optical feedback resistant partially-corrugated-waveguide laser diodes
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Based on a novel analysis for dynamic optical feedback resistance in single mode LDs, the mechanism of superior external optical feedback resistant characteristics in PC-LDs was clarified. Theoretical and experimental results demonstrated that PC-LDs are applicable to isolator-free LD modules with high yield for high capacity optical access network systems.

articleTitle: The impact of LOC-structures on 670 nm (Al)GaInP highpower lasers
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: From a fabrication series of large optical cavity (LOC) broad area semiconductor quantum well lasers with varying waveguide width we got minimal /spl alpha//sub 1/<1cm/sup -1/ resulting in /spl eta//sup d/=1.1 W/A for 64/spl times/2000 /spl mu/m/sup 2/ uncoated devices. Analysis of the above-threshold behaviour including temperature stability and leakage current effects results in total output powers >3.2 W qCW and >1 W CW at 20/spl deg/C.

articleTitle: Experimental and theoretical analysis of the temperature performance of high T/sub 0/ lasers on InGaAs ternary substrate
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: The temperature performance of 1.23 /spl mu/m strained quantum well lasers on InGaAs ternary substrate has been analyzed. The temperature dependence of the slope efficiency and T/sub 0/ are well explained by the suppressed carrier overflow and the Auger effects.

articleTitle: Reliable 60 watt continuous wave power InGaAs/AlGaAs (915 nm) monolithic laser diode arrays
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Higher than 180 W CW power has been demonstrated on a 1 cm wide, 48% packing density InGaAs-AlGaAs (915 nm) monolithic laser diode array. Reliable operation of the diode arrays on conductively cooled heat sinks is evidenced on 5000 hours lifetest.

articleTitle: 1.1-W continuous-wave 1480-nm unstable-cavity lasers with distributed electrodes for mode shaping
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: The distributed electrode enables to reduce spatial hole-burning effects, therefore improving the modal behavior of diffraction-limited MQW lasers. We report the first realization of such devices emitting 1.1 W nearly single mode at 1480 nm.

articleTitle: Determination of the influence of Auger recombination on the threshold current of 1.3 /spl mu/m and 1.5 /spl mu/m InGaAs(P) strained-layer lasers and its variation with temperature
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We investigated the influence of Auger recombination from 90 K to above room temperature and found its contribution to the threshold current at 300 K to be about 80% and 50% at 1.5 /spl mu/m and at 1.3 /spl mu/m respectively.

articleTitle: High performance 1.3 /spl mu/m InAsP SL-QW ACIS (Al-oxide confined inner stripe) lasers
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: A low threshold of 2 mA, a high quantum efficiency of 67% and a stable single transverse mode operations have been obtained in newly developed 1.3 μm Al-oxide confined inner stripe (ACIS) lasers with modulation-doped quantum wells.

articleTitle: High power and short wavelength red DFB lasers
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We demonstrate the shortest wavelength and highest power red InGaP QW DFB lasers. Operating from 635 nm to 680 nm, these devices provide single mode powers up to 50 mW, and are finding applications in interferometry, spectroscopy and optical storage.

articleTitle: 1.3 /spl mu/m GaInAsP lasers integrated with monitoring photodiodes through highly reflective semiconductor/air Bragg reflector (SABAR)
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We have demonstrated an integration with a laser and a monitoring photodiode through a highly reflective semiconductor/air Bragg reflector (SABAR), for the first time. Experimentally obtained SABAR reflectivity is as high as 80%. Threshold characteristics of ridge waveguide lasers and photocurrent behavior of monitor photodiodes are evaluated.

articleTitle: InGaAlP Zn-diffused window structure laser diodes fabricated by using highly Zn-doped GaAs layers
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: 685 nm InGaAlP window structure laser diodes have been obtained with a new Zn diffusion method utilizing highly Zn-doped GaAs layers as a Zn source. The method has some advantages and superior controllability.

articleTitle: Ultra-low chirp EAM-DFB-LD for 2.5 Gbps-700 km penalty-free transmission
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We have fabricated a distributed-feedback laser diode (DFB-LD) with monolithically integrated electroabsorption modulator (EAM), which has small chirp characteristics (effective /spl alpha/ parameter =0.2). 2.5 Gbps-700 km penalty-free transmission without any intentional pre-biasing or self phase modulation effect is successfully demonstrated using the EAM-LD.

articleTitle: CW and dynamic stable polarized light emission from VCSELs grown on [311]B substrate by MOCVD
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Stable polarized light emission from VCSELs grown on [311]B substrates by MOCVD has been achieved under CW and dynamic operations, in contrast with VCSELs on [100] substrates. A polarization extinction ratio of 9 dB under zero-biased modulation was obtained. The fabricated VCSELs consisted of Si-doped DBR, three GaAs/AlGaAs quantum well active region sandwiched between one-wavelength thick AlGaAs spacer layers, and a C-doped DBR.

articleTitle: The optical output of the mode-locked p-Ge hot hole THz laser
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: A detailed study of the optical output of the mode locked p-Ge hot hole THz laser in low B-field has been performed. Preliminary results on wavelength dependent gain and pulse shape are presented.

articleTitle: Effects of quantum well recombination losses on the internal differential efficiency of multi-quantum-well lasers
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Non-uniform carrier distribution in InGaAsP-InP multi-quantum-well (MQW) laser diodes is found to cause QW recombination losses to increase with rising injection current above threshold. These losses can have a larger effect on the internal differential efficiency than carrier leakage.

articleTitle: Monolithic 2D-VCSEL array with >2 W CW output power
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: CW output power in excess of 2 watts was obtained from an InGaAs DBR MQW VCSEL array. This is the highest CW power achieved from a monolithic VCSEL structure to date. We report the performance of several VCSEL arrays. By active cooling of the laser arrays, we were able to repeatedly generate >2 W CW output power at 940 nm. This is the highest CW output power achieved from a monolithic VCSEL array to date.

articleTitle: Degradation behavior of narrow-spectral-linewidth DFB lasers for super wideband FM conversion
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: The feasibility of using narrow-spectral-linewidth DFB lasers as analog sources used in optical heterodyne FM converters is shown based on the degradation modes. There is no change in the dynamic properties, such as FM response, CSO, and CTB, while spectral linewidth increases.

articleTitle: Extreme reduction of timing jitter in a subharmonic synchronous mode-locked laser diode
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Extreme timing jitter reduction less than the master laser pulse's jitter was achieved in a subharmonic synchronous mode-locked laser diode. This was found to be originated from short term stability between neighboring pulses in passive mode-locking operation.

articleTitle: Quantum description of noise in saturated semiconductor optical amplifiers; analysis of generation of squeezed states
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We describe the relative intensity noise (RIN) and phase noise properties of semiconductor optical amplifiers operating in the nonlinear regime. We demonstrate the possibility of noise supression below the shot noise limit under some operating conditions.

articleTitle: Tensile-strained GaAs/sub 1-y/P/sub y/-AlGaAs quantum well diode lasers emitting between 715 nm and 790 nm
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Tensile-strained GaAs/sub 1-y/P/sub y/ QWs in LOC-AlGaAs structures for high power lasers at wavelengths below 800 nm were studied. At 735 nm a threshold current density of 180 A/cm/sup 2/ and a wall plug efficiency of 50% at 1.8 W have been achieved.

articleTitle: Sampled grating DBR lasers with 22 nm quasi-continuous tuning and monolithically integrated wavelength monitors
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Reports on a widely tunable sampled-grating DBR laser with an integrated wavelength monitor. The laser has a 22 nm quasi-continuous tuning range, which enables it to reach 27 WDM channels spaced at 100 GHz with equal output power and greater than 40 dB of SMSR. The integrated monitor provides a differential feedback signal that enables the wavelength of the laser to be tracked over a 30 nm range with a resolution of 0.44 nm.

articleTitle: High-power, single-mode, simplified antiresonant reflecting optical waveguide (S-ARROW) distributed feedback semiconductor lasers
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: A novel type of single-mode device: the simplified ARROW structure; together with a DFB grating provides, at λ=0.97 μm, stable, single-frequency CW operation to 157 mW in a stable, narrow (θ/sub 1/2 /=4.5°) beam, with a RIN level of -154 dB/Hz to 8 GHz.

articleTitle: Fabrication and modeling of optical interconnects using selective area growth metalorganic chemical vapor deposition
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: A computational model for selective area growth has been verified using a comprehensive suite of experimental measurements: atomic force microscopy, optical interference microscopy, microphotoluminescence, and micro-Xray diffraction. The model then allows for constructive engineering of the material thickness and composition through manipulation of the oxide mask used in selective area growth. This can be a fundamental input to the design of optical interconnects and integrated photonic devices.

articleTitle: Reliability improvement of 980 nm laser diodes with a new facet passivation process
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: A newly developed facet passivation method producing highly reliable, high output power 980 nm InGaAs MQW laser diodes (LDs) is described. Even with facet cleavage in air, the devices exhibit a maximum output of 500 mW. Aging tests at 200-250 mW showed very good performance.

articleTitle: Widely wavelength tunable picosecond pulse generation using gain-switched DBR lasers
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Systematic investigations of pulse generation using gain-switched DBR lasers have been performed at 5 GHz and 10 GHz. The pulse width is less than 40 ps for both repetition rates and remains constant over the 13 nm tuning range of the device. The optimal condition to generate the pulse is defined by the cavity mode position inside the Bragg filter.

articleTitle: DFB laser diodes operating at 785 and 852 nm
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: DFB laser diodes operating at 785 and 852 nm, with threshold currents of 25 and 13 mA, respectively, slope efficiency of 0.8 W/A and thermal tuning of 0.06-0.07 nn/°C have been described. Preliminary lifetest data are presented.

articleTitle: Observation of reduced non-radiative recombination current in 1.3-/spl mu/m AlGaInAs/InP multiple-quantum-well lasers
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We investigated experimentally the temperature dependence of the threshold current in 1.3-/spl mu/m AlGaInAs-InP MQW lasers, and found that compared with GaInAsP-InP devices the higher characteristic temperature was caused by a reduction of the non-radiative recombination current.

articleTitle: Novel approach to the spontaneous emission factor
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: The spontaneous emission factor /spl beta/ is studied as a function of electron density and wavelength for diode lasers. A new functional form for /spl beta/ is suggested and applied to experimental measurements on a DFB laser.

articleTitle: Wide bandwidth on-chip mirror for WDM emitters: integration with a laser Mach-Zehnder modulator
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: A wide bandwidth on-chip mirror using deeply etched Bragg gratings localised over 10 /spl mu/m is presented; it enables reflectivity over more than 25 nm. Integration within a laser-modulator structure is shown and the WDM capability demonstrated over 20 nm.

articleTitle: Electroluminescence, photoconductivity and lasing studies of quantum wire lasers with spatial resolution of 0.1 /spl mu/m
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: V-grooved quantum wire (QWR) lasers were studied by near-field optical microscopy with 0.1 /spl mu/m spatial resolution. We mapped the electroluminescence from the quantum structures and measured the lasing mode evolution. Localized photocurrent measurements show spectral features consistent with the QWR lateral confinement.

articleTitle: 650 nm lasers with narrow far-field divergence
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We have reduced the measured vertical far-field divergence in a 650 nm strained SQW laser from 35/spl deg/ to 21/spl deg/ (FWHM), without changing the threshold current, operating voltage or thermal impedance, by introducing additional optical mode expansion layers.

articleTitle: Microscopic simulation of InGaAsP diode laser performance
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We have developed a microscopic model for a semiconductor diode laser which includes the physical transport of carriers, the quantum processes associated with the quantum wells (capture and gain) and the photon modes, all self consistently as a function of the device bias. Detailed comparison to experiment for electrical and optical properties shows the reliability of the model. Simulation shows that in a conventional multi-quantum well active layer device, the carrier distribution among the wells can be quite non-uniform. We propose that this is the fundamental explanation for the dependence of high speed operation on p-doping.

articleTitle: High-efficiency laterally-oxidized InGaAs-AlGaAs single-mode lasers
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We report on results of laterally wet-oxidized laser diodes operating in single lateral and longitudinal mode. The devices achieve output powers of up to 140 mW at wall-plug efficiencies of 63% in continuous wave operation.

articleTitle: Present status and prospects of blue light emitting semiconductor lasers
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: The InGaN multi-quantum-well-structure laser diodes grown on an epitaxially laterally overgrown GaN on sapphire had an output power as high as 420 mW per facet under RT-CW operation and a lifetime of 250 hours at a constant output power of 30 mW under CW operation at an ambient temperature of 50/spl deg/C.

articleTitle: Quantum cascade lasers: from band structure engineering to applications
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Quantum cascade (QC) lasers are fundamentally new semiconductor light sources in that: (1) their wavelength can be tailored over a wide range (from 3.4 /spl mu/m to 17 /spl mu/m) using the same combination of materials by a suitable choice of the active layer thicknesses (a few nanometers), (2) their optical power is greatly enhanced by the cascade effect (one injected electron creates 25-30 photons in traversing the active region). They are a textbook case of band structure engineering since all key microscopic properties (energy levels, radiative and non radiative matrix elements and their corresponding lifetimes, etc.) are designed "bottom-up" to optimize material and device performance.

articleTitle: 1.5 /spl mu/m buried heterostructure InGaAsP/InP MQW laser with native-oxidized InAlAs current blocking layer
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We first proposed and realized a 1.5 /spl mu/m buried hetero-structure InGaAsP-InP MQW laser with a native-oxidized InAlAs current block layer (NO-InAlAs-BH). The primary results are Ith=5.6 mA, slope efficiency /spl eta/=0.23 mW/mA and an linear output power surpassing 22.5 mW.

articleTitle: High performance DFB laser diodes with monolithically integrated waveguide lens
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: The DFB-LD with a width-tapered waveguide lens is fabricated and narrow beam divergence property is realized. Excellent light output-current (L-l) characteristics in wide-temperature range and error-floor-free transmission at 622 Mbps-40 km are also confirmed. It is promising for the surface-mountable DFB-LD modules.

articleTitle: Chirp-compensated 40-GHz mode-locked lasers integrated with electroabsorption modulators and chirped gratings
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: The chirp characteristics of 40-GHz mode-locked lasers integrated with electroabsorption modulators and chirped gratings are investigated. Nearly transform-limited pulses of less than 4 ps are generated over a wide range of frequencies from 38 GHz to 41 GHz.

articleTitle: Low-threshold continuous-wave operation of 2.38 /spl mu/m GaInAsSb/GaSb type-II quantum-well laser diodes
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Strained GaInAsSb/GaSb type-II multiquantum well ridge waveguide laser diodes have operated near 2.38 /spl mu/m in the continuous regime for the first time at 23/spl deg/C, with threshold current in the range 60-150 mA and CW output power of /spl sim/1 mW/facet.

articleTitle: Reduction of second- and third-order harmonic distortion by nonlinear absorption in gain-coupled DFB lasers
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: The analog modulation distortion due to nonlinear gain compression has been found to be reduced significantly in the gain-coupled (GC) DFB laser of absorptive grating type. It is because the gain compression is compensated by the loss compression in the grating. In order to investigate whether this effect really exists or not, we here analyzed second and third harmonic distortions (2HD and 3HD) in GC DFB LDs of absorptive grating type numerically, taking the dynamic nature of the absorptive grating into consideration.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 2.5 Gb/s at 3.6 watts using a semiconductor flared optical amplifier
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We demonstrate direct modulation of a InGaAs flared semiconductor amplifier at 2.5 Gb/s at peak powers of 3.6 W (ave. power of 1.8 W). This is the highest single mode power from any high speed semiconductor source.

articleTitle: Band-gap engineered, QCSE tuned laser with uniform frequency modulation response
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We report the first post-growth band-gap engineered, quantum-confined Stark effect (QCSE) tuned two section ridge waveguide MQW laser, having the widest and most uniform frequency modulation bandwidth (30 kHz to 6 GHz/spl plusmn/3 dB) yet reported for field effect tuned lasers.

articleTitle: Spatial emission control of vertical cavity surface emitting lasers to provide bandwidth gain in multimode fibre links using a simple alignment technique
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Etched VCSEL sources are reported which avoid bandwidth collapse in multimode fibre using a simple coupling technique to control the launch. These devices have allowed for a better over-filled launch bandwidth for alignment tolerances of /spl plusmn/7 microns.

articleTitle: High temperature GaInAs/AlGaAs lasers with improved carrier confinement due to short period superlattice quantum well barriers
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: The high temperature properties of GaInAs-AlGaAs lasers were improved by using short period superlattice barriers. Record T/sub 0/-values of 320 K (up to 75/spl deg/C) and maximum operating temperatures above 240/spl deg/C could be achieved.

articleTitle: Polarization properties of longitudinal-cavity V-groove quantum wire lasers
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: The optimization of V-groove-MOCVD grown quantum wire lasers, including the polarization properties, is studied using vectorial eigenmodes and QWR gain spectra (4/spl times/4 k/spl middot/p method). The results are also of interest to interpret future near field scanning optical microscopy (NSOM) measurements.

articleTitle: A spot-size converter integrated optical transceiver diode with a bulk detection layer for broad-wavelength range and high-speed TCM operation
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We clarify the impact of the detection layer on the dynamic properties of an optical transceiver diode (TRAD) for use in time compression multiplexing (TCM) systems. We obtained successful transceiver operation at 155.52 Mbps, including switching operation. We show the possibility of operation at over several hundred Mbps over a broad range of wavelengths and temperatures.

articleTitle: Wavelength-independent performance of multiple-wavelength vertical-cavity laser arrays using modal gain engineering
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: A novel method of modal gain engineering is proposed and demonstrated for the first time. By arranging the quantum wells' physical and spectral positions to obtain maximum modal gain for each wavelength, wavelength-independent performance of multiple wavelength VCSELs can be achieved.

articleTitle: Q-switched and mode-locked QW diode lasers with implanted multisectional saturable absorber
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: A process of implantation of high energy heavy ions into the emitter layer of a semiconductor laser has been developed to create distributed ultrafast saturable absorber regions integrated within the cavity of a QW laser. A picosecond Q-switched laser diode delivering increased average power has been fabricated and multiple colliding pulse modelocked regime has been demonstrated with QW diode lasers having an implanted multisectional saturable absorber.

articleTitle: Designing better AlGaInP based visible VCSELs
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: AlGaInP edge emitting lasers with AlGaAs cladding mimic the GaInP SQW active region of surface-emitters. We use these to determine limitations in the absence of cavity effects and predict much improved visible VCSELs will now be possible.

articleTitle: Narrow linewidth phase-lockable high power /spl alpha/-DFB laser
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: The free running spectral linewidth of a high-power /spl alpha/-DFB laser at 1064 nm is measured to be less than 100 kHz. Electronic feedback to the injection current is used to phaselock the /spl alpha/-DFB laser to a diode pumped Nd-YAG laser.

articleTitle: Self-sustained pulsation at 65/spl deg/C through reduced carrier overflow in AlGaInP laser diodes
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Self-sustained pulsation operation of AlGaInP laser diodes at up to 65/spl deg/C was obtained. This was achieved by suppressing the carrier overflow, which was confirmed by analyzing the luminescence change brought about by inducing strain in the wells of the active and saturable-absorbing layers.

articleTitle: Ultrafast light and gain dynamics of GCSOAs by femtosecond cross-gain modulation
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We have evidenced co- and counter-propagating dark pulses in the laser mode of gain clamped semiconductor optical amplifiers (GCSOA)s perturbed by an intense ultrafast pulse. They decay into a long-lived two mode beating. The resulting gain modulation may be a limiting factor for applications.

articleTitle: Room-temperature pulsed operation of 1.5 /spl mu/m triple fused vertical cavity surface emitting lasers with in-situ built-in lateral current confinement
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Operation of a new triple fused long wavelength VCSEL structure is demonstrated for the first time. In this structure both highly resistive p-AlGaAs/GaAs DBR and strained p-GaAs/p-InP fused junction are replaced with a composite mirror comprising a p-InGaAsP/InP partial DBR fused to an undoped AlGaAs/GaAs DBR and an isoperiodic, low barrier p-InP/p-InGaAsP fused junction.

articleTitle: Amplitude noise squeezing performances of semiconductor lasers: VCSELs versus edge emitters
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We demonstrate first successful squeezing of single-polarisation mode VCSELs, and present comprehensive and comparative, both theoretical and experimental studies of the influence of spectral, spatial and polarisation modes on the squeezing performance of edge emitters and VCSELs.

articleTitle: Multiwavelength micro-array semiconductor lasers
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Densely arrayed (pitch <10 /spl mu/m) semiconductor lasers with individually controlled lasing wavelengths, we call them micro-array semiconductor lasers, were developed as fundamental wavelength-selectable light sources. Over 80-nm eight different wavelengths lasings were achieved from a chip with a laser section 70-/spl mu/m wide and 400-/spl mu/m long. We propose a novel epitaxial growth technique which can form densely arrayed LDs with different wavelengths. This technique is called micro-array selective epitaxy (MASE). The gain peak wavelengths of such microarray LDs can be changed individually over several tens of nanometers.

articleTitle: Far-infrared spontaneous emission from quantum dot and quantum well structures accompanying near-infrared lasing
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Spontaneous radiation from laser structures with quantum dots connected with hole and electron interlevel transitions was found and investigated. The radiation is observed only under simultaneous stimulated interband emission and has a similar current threshold.

articleTitle: Monolithically integrated MZI-SOA configuration for polarization independent optical phase conjugation with pump filtering
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Demonstration of polarization independent optical phase conjugation by four-wave mixing in a monolithic Mach Zehnder interferometric semiconductor optical amplifier (MZI-SOA) configuration. An integrated filtering mechanism for the pump-signal enhances the conjugate-to-pump ratio by 15 dB compared to the single SOA case.

articleTitle: Temperature insensitive characteristics of 1.06 /spl mu/m strain-compensated single quantum well laser diodes (SQW-LDs)
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Temperature insensitive characteristics have been demonstrated in single mode 1.06 μm InGaAs SQW-LDs with AlGaInP current blocking layer and GaAsP barrier layers which act as strain compensation and electron barriers.

articleTitle: Gain calculations for localized excitons and biexcitons: (In,Ga)N versus (Zn,Cd)Se quantum wells
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We present a comparative theoretical study of the energy states and optical gain of inhomogeneously broadened localized excitons and biexcitons in (Zn,Cd)Se/ZnSe and (In,Ga)N/GaN quantum wells.

articleTitle: Mechanism of polarisation pinning in vertical cavity surface emitting lasers using focused ion beam etching
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Photoluminescence experiments have identified strain as the origin for polarisation pinning in GaAs top-emitting vertical cavity surface emitting QW lasers post-processed by focused ion beam etching. Theoretical models were applied to deduce the strain in devices. Post-annealing was used to optimise polarisation pinning.

articleTitle: Improved characteristic temperature of 780 nm AlGaAs/AlGaInP QW laser-diodes for high speed laser beam printer applications
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Reduced leakage current in 780 nm AlGaAs lasers-diodes is obtained for the first time by replacing AlGaAs cladding layers with AlGaInP ones. The overall temperature performance of the laser-diode is now drastically improved (T/sub 0/>200 K) resulting in a record low droop value (D<4%) over a wide temperature- and power range making these lasers extremely suitable for high-end laser beam printers.

articleTitle: Picosecond near- and far-field dynamics of a gain-guided broad area laser
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We present picosecond time-resolved single-shot streak camera measurements of the emission of a broad area laser, demonstrating that the dynamical filamentation in the near-field is linked to dynamical beam steering in the far-field.

articleTitle: Fabrication and performances of AlGaAs-GaAs wavelength distributed feedback lasers and distributed Bragg reflector lasers utilizing first-order diffraction grating formed by periodic groove structure
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Distributed feedback (DFB) lasers and distributed Bragg reflector (DBR) lasers using a grooved grating structure with 1.50 nm period are demonstrated on an InGaAs-GaAs strained quantum well active wafer without a re-growth process. The lasers exhibit a sharply controlled spectra with threshold currents of 14 mA as low as those of conventional Fabry Perot type lasers.

articleTitle: Universal rule for determining the critical temperature in the high-temperature characteristics of quantum well lasers operating at 1.3 /spl mu/m
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We derive a universal rule for determining the critical temperature (T/sub c/) of 1.3-/spl mu/m quantum-well (QW) lasers on the basis of Landau theory of second-order phase transition. We demonstrate that, contrary to expectations, an optimum well depth, which brings about the maximum T/sub c/, depends on a given cavity loss. The maximum T/sub c/'s possible for InGaAsP and AlGaInAs QW lasers are also demonstrated.

articleTitle: The refractive index change in QW lasers
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: For the first time, we present a complete theoretical description of the refractive index change in QW lasers induced by charged carriers. For both TE and TM polarized light, the various components of the refractive index change are calculated.

articleTitle: Femtosecond dynamics in semiconductor lasers: experiment and theory of 'dark pulse' formation
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We track the continuous-wave and femtosecond dynamics of semiconductor lasers after femtosecond pulse injection. The recirculating pulse evolves into a quasistable ultrafast 'dark pulse', accounted for by a simple numerical model. We report high-dynamic-range femtosecond measurements on the evolution of ultrashort pulses in continuous-wave LDs. The experiments were performed on 770 nm AlGaAs and on 1.5 /spl mu/m InGaAsP edge-emitting quantum-well LDs. A single femtosecond pulse centred on the lasing wavelength is injected and the LD output is time-resolved by upconversion in a nonlinear crystal.

articleTitle: Low threshold and high output power lasing of columnar-shaped self-assembled InAs-GaAs quantum dots
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Lasing with a low threshold current of 5.4 mA and a high output power of 110 mW was achieved using a novel closely-stacked quantum dots having high uniformity and high emission efficiency.

articleTitle: High-performance, reliable, 730 nm-emitting Al-free active region diode lasers
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Compressively-strained InGaAsP QW active (/spl lambda/=732 nm) diode lasers achieve 2.4 W CW front-facet power from 100 /spl mu/m-wide apertures, with reliable operation at 0.5 W CW. Record-high characteristic temperatures for the threshold current and the differential quantum efficiency, T/sub 0/=115 K and T/sub 1/=285 K are obtained by growing on misoriented substrates.

articleTitle: Gain-coupled DFB lasers with reduced optical confinement for narrow spectral-linewidth
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Effect of reducing optical confinement in DFB lasers on spectral linewidth as well as single-mode stability are clarified, for the first time. A narrow spectral-linewidth of 74 kHz, which is the narrowest ever reported in gain-coupled DFB lasers, is realized.

articleTitle: Semiconductor laser with deep etched distributed Bragg reflectors supporting a planar Gaussian mode
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Compact semiconductor lasers supporting a planar Gaussian mode are demonstrated. The feedback elements consist of deep etched distributed Bragg reflectors with a curvature that contours the phase front of the Gaussian wave. Low threshold current is achieved for a cavity as short as 90 /spl mu/m.

articleTitle: Narrow linewidth, high speed, AlInGaAs, strained MQW, 1.55 /spl mu/m, DFB laser diodes
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Extremely narrow linewidth (⩽100 kHz), DFB laser diodes using an optimized strain-compensated eight quantum well AlInGaAs active region with 20 GHz f/sub -3dB/ are presented.

articleTitle: Novel buried-heterostructure strained-multiple-quantum-well lasers with oxidized insulating current-blocking layers
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We have proposed and demonstrated novel planar-buried-heterostructure InGaAsP semiconductor MQW lasers that include oxidized AlAs current-blocking layers. These layers provide strong current confinement, thus enabling excellent lasing performance such as a threshold current of 6 mA, a slope efficiency of 0.51 W/A under CW condition and a maximum output power of up to 150 mW under pulsed condition, achieved at 25°C.

articleTitle: Recent progress in vertical cavity surface emitting lasers
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Efficient VCSELs are available in the 750 to 1050 nm wavelength range. Devices are based on InAlGaAs materials and MOVPE or MBE crystal growth. Typically, modulation doped, low resistance AlGaAs Bragg reflectors are monolithically integrated with one wavelength thick quantum well containing active layers.

articleTitle: High T/sub 0/ 1.3 /spl mu/m AlGaInAs/InP distributed feedback laser with complex-coupled grating growth by LP-MOCVD
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: A high T/sub 0/ 1.3 /spl mu/m AlGaInAs-InP MQW DFB laser, which was grown by LP-MOCVD, is demonstrated for the first time. The T/sub 0/ is up to 98K and the drop of 0.5dB in slope efficiency is achieved within 20 C to 80 C. A DFB laser with current blocking grating was realized successfully.

articleTitle: High power quantum cascade lasers
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: High power quantum cascade lasers emitting at /spl lambda//spl sim/8 /spl mu/m are reported that make optimum use of the cascading scheme, in which electrons sequentially traversing N/sub p/ (typically N/sub p//spl sim/30) stacked active regions emit N/sub p/ laser photons. A near optimum performance was achieved by optimizing the design of the active regions and injectors. Additionally, the waveguide cladding layers were made from InP, the lower cladding being formed by the InP substrate, the upper cladding by InP grown by molecular beam epitaxy (MBE) using solid source phosphorous. This helps to improve in particular the high temperature performance of the lasers. The active region is of the so-called "three well vertical transition" design and consists of three InGaAs quantum wells closely coupled by thin AlInAs barriers.

articleTitle: Chirp in an external-cavity laser diode with an intracavity frequency shifter
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We clarify for the first time that cavity mode frequencies in an external-cavity laser diode with an intracavity frequency shifter are chirping spatially as well as temporally in the cavity. Both chirping rates are measured and compared with the theoretical relations.

articleTitle: Observation of near field modal emission in InGaN multi-quantum well laser diodes by near field scanning optical microscopy
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Near field scanning optical microscopy was used to measure the near field modal profile of InGaN MQW laser diodes. Below threshold the field profile is double lobed with the larger portion of the optical energy residing in the unintentional waveguide formed by the sapphire-GaN-InGaN-AlGaN.

articleTitle: Ultralow loss oxide-aperture VCSELs
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Ultralow-loss, vertical cavity lasers fabricated with thin oxide apertures at the node of the optical field exhibit reduced sensitivity of device parameters to aperture sizes <5.0 μm. Thresholds currents of 52 μA are achieved.

articleTitle: Demonstration of optical noise reduction using nonlinear absorption in semiconductor laser amplifier
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We propose a new way to use the InGaAs MQW semiconductor laser amplifier as an ultra fast noise reduction device. We have successfully confirmed the receiver sensitivity improvement for 0.5 dB in 5 Gb/s NRZ signal by using this principle.

articleTitle: Auger carrier kinetics and high-speed performance of self-assembled quantum dot lasers
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Self-assembled quantum dot laser with pump of lasing levels purely through Auger carrier capture is analyzed. Analysis shows that Auger processes can provide effective laser pumping and fast modulation at least up to 10 GHz.

articleTitle: 40 mW, 100/spl deg/C maximum temperature operation of 655-nm band InGaP/InGaAlP strained multiple-quantum-well laser diodes
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: 40 mW, 100/spl deg/C maximum temperature operations have been realized in 655-nm band InGaP-InGaAlP strained multiple quantum-well laser diodes. Fundamental-transverse-mode operations up to 50 mW, high-frequency-modulation characteristics above 1 GHz, and furthermore, 70/spl deg/C, 30 mW stable operations over 1000 hours were demonstrated.

articleTitle: Polarization anisotropy in asymmetric oxide-aperture VCSELs
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Strong polarization discrimination is observed from asymmetric oxide-aperture VCSELs. Direction of dominant polarization is perpendicular to the longer edge of the slit-shaped oxide aperture. Polarization extinction ratio up to 184 is observed from a 1.4-/spl mu/m oxide aperture VCSEL.

articleTitle: Flip-chip bonded arrays of monolithically integrated, microlensed vertical cavity lasers and resonant photodetectors
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We present flip-chip bonded arrays of novel, monolithically integrated, microlensed vertical-cavity lasers (VCLs) and resonant photodetectors. The bottom emitting VCLs exhibit ∼300 μA threshold currents, while adjacent detectors have the same operating wavelength and responsivities of ∼0.4 A/W. Only a single epitaxial growth is required.

articleTitle: Low operating current and high temperature operation of 650 nm AlGaInP high power laser diodes with real refractive index guided self-aligned structure
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Low operating current and high temperature operation has been achieved in 650 nm AlGaInP high power double quantum well laser diodes with a real refractive index guided self-aligned (RISA) structure. The attained operating current for 50 mW CW at 70/spl deg/C is as low as 98 mA, which is almost a half of the lowest value ever reported.

articleTitle: Optical gain properties of 1.3-/spl mu/m n-type modulation-doped MQW lasers for parallel optical interconnections
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate, for the first time, that the transparent carrier density is reduced in the 1.3-μm n-type modulation-doped MQW laser. This reduction causes the decrease in threshold current and the increase in the slope efficiency.

articleTitle: Dual-purpose vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers for data communications applications
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: A modified vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser (VCSEL), functioning both as a light source and an avalanche photo-detector, is introduced and characterised. A link system implementing dual-purpose devices is described.

articleTitle: Multi-wavelength picosecond pulse generation using a monolithically integrated multi-wavelength grating cavity (MGC) laser
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Multi-wavelength picosecond pulses are demonstrated using a single monolithically integrated multi-wavelength grating cavity (MGC) InGaAs-InGaAsP-InP laser. This is achieved on two WDM wavelength channels at a repetition rate of 7.63 GHz.

articleTitle: Measurement of amplitude and frequency modulation responses of widely tunable GCSR lasers
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: The amplitude and frequency modulation responses of a grating assisted codirectional coupler (GCSR) semiconductor laser were measured over 40 nm tuning range. The extracted modulation bandwidth varied between 3 and 4 GHz and the linewidth enhancement factors range from 3 to 9.

articleTitle: 1.3 /spl mu/m InGaAsP/InP strained-layer MQW lasers fabricated by reactive ion etching and MOVPE regrowth with CH/sub 3/Cl addition
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Using reactive ion etching and MOVPE regrowth with CH/sub 3/Cl addition, 1.3 /spl mu/m InGaAsP-InP BH lasers with excellent high temperature characteristics and uniformity were fabricated. A narrow-beam-divergence laser with tapered stripe width is also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Negative differential resistance of an intracavity voltage-controlled absorber in a vertical cavity surface emitting laser
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We present the first detailed investigation of the sharp negative differential resistance (NDR) within a VCSEL intracavity quantum well absorber. The intensity dependent NDR is governed by the position of the Fabry-Perot wavelength relative to the absorber excitonic peak.

articleTitle: High power 1.55 /spl mu/m DFB laser diode with built-in vertically tapered mode expander
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We report a high power DFB laser diode integrated with a vertical mode expander. The device delivered over 115 mW single mode laser power in a circular beam profile with the FWHM divergence angles of 9.5/spl deg//spl times/13.5.

articleTitle: Two-dimensional photonic crystals for GaN-based blue light emitters
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We successfully fabricated two-dimensional photonic crystal structures for III-nitride light emitters by integrating electron-beam lithography, xenon/chlorine-based chemically assisted ion beam etching and a multilayer pattern transfer.

articleTitle: Cryogenic high-speed operation of double-fused 1.5 /spl mu/m vertical-cavity lasers
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We report on continuous-wave operation of long-wavelength vertical-cavity InGaAsP-InP MQW lasers over a wide temperature range from 7 K to 300 K. Modulation current efficiencies of 1.4 GHz/mA/sup 1/2/ (291 K) and of 3.1 GHz/mA/sup 1/2/ (180 K) are measured.

articleTitle: Waveguide grating router laser having integrated amplified output coupler for high-extinction-ratio modulation with single-mode behavior
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We present a 16-channel waveguide grating router multifrequency laser that can be modulated with a 250-MHz bandwidth, a 50-dB extinction ratio, and constant single-mode behavior. The laser is especially suitable for fiber dispersion-map measurements.

articleTitle: Gas source MBE growth of TlInGaP and TlInGaAs for the application to temperature-insensitive wavelength semiconductor lasers
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: This paper reports the gas source MBE growth of new semiconductor TlInGaP and TlInGaAs layers on InP substrates and the observation of very low temperature-dependence of bandgap energy for these layers.

articleTitle: Pump-power dependence of intraband scattering times in semiconductor optical amplifiers
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Using a new and simple-yet very general-formalism we show that the response times characterizing the intraband dynamics in semiconductor optical amplifiers shorten at high levels of optical excitation and predict a significant increase of the four-wave mixing bandwidth.

articleTitle: InGaAsN laser structures and LEDs at 1.3 /spl mu/m grown on GaAs substrate by AP-MOVPE
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We report on experimental characterisation of long wavelength InGaAsN semiconductor structures grown on GaAs substrate for optoelectronic applications. The InGaAsN/GaAs structures were grown by AP-MOCVD, using DMHY and TBAs. GaAs:n/InGaAsN/GaAs:p Fabry-Perot laser diodes were processed from the wafers, and stimulated emission was observed under electrical injection at peak wavelength from 1.15 /spl mu/m to 1.38 /spl mu/m. Laser operation was achieved at quasi-room temperature (10/spl deg/C) for the 1.16 /spl mu/m and 1.275 /spl mu/m laser structures.

articleTitle: Top spatial filter Bragg waveguide VCSEL
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We have designed and fabricated a novel VCSEL device which incorporates a cylindrical Bragg waveguide (BW) across the VCSEL. A cylindrical Bragg waveguide is composed of a series of concentric annuli of alternating high and low refractive indices surrounding a central core. The first prototype of this VCSEL performs as a single mode device with a waveguide core diameter of 20 /spl mu/m.

articleTitle: Optical near field probe action in a microdisk laser with /spl lambda//10 resolution
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated the near field probe action in a 1.6 μm GaInAsP microdisk injection laser. A high spatial resolution of 164 nm, which was nearly 1/10 of the lasing wavelength, was evaluated for a δ-function-like object.

articleTitle: High average power density (0.2-0.65 kW/cm/sup 2/) diode laser stacks for 808 nm, 915 nm & 940 nm wavelengths
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: Combining developments in high-power (/spl sim/100 W) laser diode arrays and high heat flux (kW/cm/sup 2/) water-cooled Cu-'mini-channel' heatsinks, we demonstrate record average power density operation of diode laser stacks. Using advanced die attachment, record CW power levels of 180 W and 108 W has been demonstrated at 915 nm & 808 nm, respectively, from 1 cm wide laser arrays on such heatsinks.

articleTitle: Monolithically integrated InGaAs-AlGaAs master oscillator power amplifier with grating outcoupler
publicationTitle: Conference Digest. ISLC 1998 NARA. 1998 IEEE 16th International Semiconductor Laser Conference (Cat. No. 98CH361130)
abstract: A monolithically integrated InGaAs-AlGaAs strained QW master oscillator power laser amplifier with a grating outcoupler, fabricated without regrowth and emitting a collimated beam, is demonstrated. Stable single mode lasing up to 124 mW output was obtained under CW operation.
